summary: A layered knowledge interface can reduce orientation cost, but it must distinguish generated views, authoritative records and unverified agent notes.

points.text: Assign an owner, source of truth and freshness signal to every high-level map; a plausible stale map is worse than an explicit gap.
Link overview nodes to code, decisions, incidents, current issues and runtime evidence so readers can descend from explanation to verification.
Agent-authored changes should arrive as attributable proposals or pass domain-specific checks; write access alone does not make knowledge self-maintaining.
